summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle in a package advertised as legacy types
details: Package @or-sdk/library-types-v1 is published as a 'Request/response v1 legacy types' library but ships a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts the platform-specific executable, chmods it, and invokes it on a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle compiled with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, using a string-array (`n7gIxM`) and a shuffle routine (`WV8StW`) to hide its contents; it is only reachable via the downloaded Bun binary and cannot be executed or inspected under the Node runtime a consumer of a types package would expect. Installing the package fires the runtime download and executes the obfuscated payload automatically on `npm install`. A types-only package has no legitimate reason to fetch an alternate language runtime or run an opaque 727 KB bundle at install; the `math_init.js` filename is inconsistent with the shipped contents.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
